sourceMappingDecisions: Reuse stable 募集 and 干す articles, adding sourced level and only directly necessary recognition/guard changes.
Map source 堀 to existing 濠: exact same reading and family, and the older article explicitly recognizes 堀 and 壕. Preserve N3 as its easiest sourced level.
Create a separate kana ほどく article for entry 1198900 rather than silently mapping to existing 解く/とく entry 1198890.
The 彫る family restricts ほる to 彫る and labels える obsolete; do not assign ほる to rare 雕る/鐫る from component readings.
Do not present search-only 投る as a production alternative to 放る.

The 盆 principal has an unmarked family/household sense; public historical examples alone do not establish a modern frequency or register classification. Practical tray/Obon teaching must not invent one.
inspectionStageAdvance.stage: Actual author reads completed before card drafting; not independent certification.
sourceAccessLimits: Twenty initial and two supplemental frozen headword captures from one authority, Digital Daijisen on Weblio, were inspected.
The initial 坊っちゃん capture contains only the novel entry, not the target lexical senses.
The 坊ちゃん and ぼっちゃん supplements actually return the target lexical entry plus the separate novel entry.
Other captured pages contain homographs and historical readings; only matching readings and senses support the target claims.
An initial transient TLS failure left no completed capture files; the serial retry completed all twenty initial captures.
All fourteen selected family chunks, twenty-two older-body chunks and six complete related kanji bodies were actually read. Principal families are included in the selected union, not counted twice.
The mining supplement adds one complete family/one sense and the complete 採掘 body: union387/904 and174 older bodies. Prepared dictionary availability is larger than actual inspection.
All267 navigation labels and31 components were read. Labels are not complete older-body inspections.
The confusable inventory was read through line157 plus targeted relevant searches, not in its entirety.
Exact filesystem checks found no 手当,手当て,衛生,お盆,トレー,農場 or放っておく article; negative glob results alone are not treated as reliable absence.
No modern frequency/register label for 盆's unmarked household sense is established. Practical tray/Obon teaching does not erase that sense from quiz adjudication.
Author inspection is not independent review, exhaustive semantic uniqueness, native-speaker certification, measured frequency or measured model-bias reduction.

quizGuardRationale: Direct symmetric nontransitive hypotheses from full titles, bodies and ordinary secondary senses, not synonym cliques or source-English string matching.
方面 includes direction, region, field and aspect; 畑/道 secondary fields and 面/角度 aspects were considered. Scope/range and vicinity are not automatically every directional area.
坊や/坊っちゃん overlap boy/son and inexperienced youth uses; 坊さん has an actual boy sense despite its priest title. Not all youth/age words are automatically equivalent.
放る includes throwing, neglected duties, abandoned work and leaving unfinished. Mere sound/spelling proximity to 放す/離す does not establish every release/separation use.
Bonus can be pay or a complimentary extra; income, prizes, all benefits and all payment actions are not automatically bonuses.
朗らか personality and clear-weather meanings are considered separately; no everyday obvious/precise substitution is asserted. Physical bright/light 明らか and clear resonant 澄む senses remain relevant.

牧場 grazing land differs from cultivated/arable land and farming households. 牧畜 is activity, not the animals themselves. 保健 health preservation/hygiene differs from every medical treatment or disinfection.

募集 preserves original 招待/集める guards and adds money-collection comparison; it is not every applicant response, final hire or selection. 干す incoming drying guards remain sufficient symmetrically; drink-up and deprivation titles are assessed separately from passive possession loss.
Poster is a displayed item; advertising/notice/signboard titles are assessed without an all-communication clique. 北極/南極 are contrasting places, not synonymous merely from shared 極.
ほどく and とく overlap untying but are separate families. Unfastening/unpacking comparisons do not create a blanket transitive/intransitive or every-opening exemption.
濠 ordinary canal sense directly overlaps 運河. 掘る mining overlaps complete 採掘; 彫る carving/engraving overlaps 彫刻/刻む, not every shaving or digging action.
ぼろ old cloth, shabby state and concealed faults require actual rag/flaw/weakness neighbors, including secondary 傷/過失. Causal blame and failed actions are not automatically flaws.

盆 household sense is unmarked, not established obsolete/rare. Family/household labels receive direct safeguards despite practical tray/Obon focus. A plate, a building or every festival is not thereby a synonym.

Correction supersedes the draft: six direct pairs added after complete evidence,104 declarations. 濠 gains source-qualified 堀 production guidance and 彫る separates material/surface marking. No kanji, title, identity, level, raw source or selected-sense change.
